WHY IT MATTERS

The stakes are real

The gap between what security teams know and what attackers exploit is widening—and the industry needs people who can close it.


At Cobalt, we don't wait for the calendar to dictate when to test. We build the tools, the teams, and the programs that keep pace with real-world risk.

OUR CULTURE

At Cobalt, our values are the foundation of everything we do.

One Cobalt

We achieve more together than we ever could alone. We believe in the Cobalt vision and care deeply about our customers, pentesters, and colleagues. Diversity drives our innovation and strengthens collaboration, enabling us to build a secure world.

Quality at Speed and Scale

We continuously evolve to deliver quality at speed and scale. We set high standards, focus on impactful outcomes, and take pride in execution that our customers and pentesters can rely on.

Lead with Grit

We persevere through challenges and take responsibility to deliver. Achievement comes from a strong work ethic, resilience, and collective accountability. We operate with discipline when it's difficult.

Innovate Relentlessly

We pursue continuous improvement without exception. Through ongoing learning and disciplined innovation, we identify new ways to reduce risk and advance what's possible in offensive security.

KEY BENEFITS

What you get at Cobalt

Compensation and Equity

Competitive base compensation with an attractive equity plan. Your contribution to this category is reflected in your stake in it.

Health and Wellness

Medical, dental, and life insurance (US). Monthly stipends covering home office setup, wellness, and learning and development—because where and how you work matters.

Time and Flexibility

Flexible PTO to support work-life balance, wherever you are. Paid parental leave.

Retirement

401(k) matching to support your long-term financial security.
